---
applyTo: "**/*.{tsx,ts,jsx,js,css,scss,dart}"
---
Use UX4G Design System 3.0 as the UI baseline. Read `DESIGN-SYSTEM.md` and `specs/design-system.yaml`. Reuse UX4G components/tokens/patterns before custom UI. JSON Forms widgets must be UX4G-backed. Do not add a parallel visual design system or hard-coded design primitives. Custom ServiceForm controls require accessibility and visual-regression evidence.
